rec.name: Spacing Section (Spacer)

what.text: A standalone Shopify section that adds an empty vertical band between two other sections. Its top and bottom padding and its background colour are set in the theme editor, with separate desktop and mobile spacing. It can be added to any template, so it works as a layout tool in A/B tests without a developer touching the theme.

why.text: Whitespace groups related content, separates unrelated blocks and sets the reading rhythm of the page. This reduces cognitive load and makes a CTA or a social-proof block easier to notice. Because spacing and colour can be changed per breakpoint without code, the agency can test layout variants quickly. This is an indirect lever with a small effect. It mainly supports other elements rather than driving conversion on its own.

how.text: 1) Create the section file `ed-spacing-section.liquid` in the theme and paste in the provided code. 2) In the theme editor, add 'Spacing Section' to any template between two sections. 3) Set the background colour and the top and bottom spacing for desktop and mobile. The CSS targets `#shopify-section-{{ section.id }}`. It applies the desktop padding from 1000px up and the mobile padding below 1000px. A transparent colour value falls back to the theme's global colour settings.

items: Background colour (default transparent, which falls back to the theme background; screenshot shows #6F719B)
Text colour (in the code only, not visible in the screenshot; default transparent, which falls back to the theme text colour)
Custom CSS field (visible in the editor panel)

dependencies.text: No metafields or apps are needed. The theme must expose the global colour settings `settings.background`, `settings.heading_color` and `settings.text_color`, which the section uses as fallbacks. It also needs standard section support (`presets`) so it can be added through the editor. The theme is assumed to wrap each section in `#shopify-section-{{ section.id }}`, as Shopify does by default. Non-devs can add the section once the file exists.

items: Scroll depth and scroll-through to the section after the spacer
Click-through rate on the CTA or block next to the spacer
Bounce rate and time on page
Conversion rate and revenue per visitor, compared by device (desktop vs mobile)

images.caption: Theme editor: the Spacing Section sits between a slideshow and a countdown timer on the home page. The purple band is the spacer, set to #6F719B with 100px top and bottom. The settings panel shows Background, Top/Bottom space, Mobile settings (60px) and Custom CSS.
